summary: This class explores the history and practice of hakafot on Simchat Torah, focusing specifically on the unique custom in Aleppo of performing seven sets of seven hakafot. The speaker details how different communities and local synagogues, including the old synagogue in Halab and Bet Nasi, divided these joyous circles across the days of Shemini Atzeret and Simchat Torah.
questions: How many hakafot are normally done on Simchat Torah?
Where did the custom of hakafot originate?
How many sets of hakafot were traditionally done in Aleppo?
Which synagogues in Brooklyn still maintain customs from Aleppo for hakafot?
